name: story-memory-stability
title: 剧情记忆压缩诊断与稳定性优化
description: Story-memory safe diagnostics, bounded archive repair, just-in-time claims and honest partial/unknown outcomes; local checks complete.
creator: cline
notes: Implementation and local checks complete. Not staged, committed, pushed, migrated or deployed. See verification.md for initial environment-induced real provider request and isolated successful test rerun. Actual upstream quality, retry guard deployment and post-release metrics remain manual gates.

mobile_performance.reason: Only detached story-memory worker, generation compressor used exclusively by that worker, and safe logging projection change. No Android/iOS page, frontend bundle, route handler, request-path memory read (50ms budget), HTTP contract or API timeout changes; model concurrency remains one per process. Therefore no page/API loading P95 target is attributable to this task. Background model latency, calls per accepted chunk, queue progress and lease safety are the direct performance scope. Shared-process contention is checked after release with existing per-OS/API telemetry; missing scoped baseline is unknown, not zero.

measurement.source: No scoped Android/iOS or API P95 samples captured; existing telemetry can detect indirect shared-process regression after release.
measurement.window: Separate Android/iOS and each existing chat API over 24h before/after actual release, recording samples and model/prompt/config version.

mobile_performance.notes: No numeric page/API objective is invented for a background-only change. Compression latency/call count and final rejection rate are the direct acceptance measures; compare existing mobile/API telemetry as an operational safeguard.

scope: Story-memory background compression, worker lifecycle and actual Pino JSON projection
integration_points: generation/story-memory-compress.ts safe response/error diagnostics through existing upstream transport
story-memory/compress-job.ts and worker.ts phase/progress within job and session ALS
observability/safe-log.ts explicit scalar projection and actual logger JSON tests
failure_paths: Over-length/empty/thinking/missing-section/shrunk archives stay rejected within three main calls
Pre-shrink rejection/exception records fallback; transport, timeout, invalid JSON, byte limit and incomplete output retain safe diagnostics
Partial commits, commit uncertainty, finish failure and lease loss preserve old memory and report real progress without mutation retries
logging_integration.correlation: Reuse runObservedJob trace/span and verified per-job withBusinessContext session/user/character; bounded chunk/range/attempt fields. No logging-only DB queries or new high-cardinality Sentry fields.
logging_integration.redaction: Only allowlisted scalar sizes/limits/usage and finite stages/reasons/model/version; no prompt/archive/history/raw response/nickname/token/secret/provider free text. Use {err} safe serializer; unknown measurements omitted.
logging_integration.alerting: Reuse final failure error and exactly-third consecutive failure Sentry alert. Intermediate repair/pre-shrink fallback warn; no new notification rule or production setting, direct log alert switch stays default-off.
verification: Assert actual Pino JSON retains lengths and true limits but excludes private payload
Existing logger/compression tests and necessary generation/worker regression files; full Backend tests/typecheck, shared tests, logging validation and static checks
Manual TEST lease/partial-progress/backoff cases, post-release per-OS/API P95 and 24h compression outcome/call-cost comparison

review.basis: User explicitly approved latest final plan: start implementation (2026-11-20).
